verdict.rationale: The only SDK-like artifact is the official npm package `@foreloop/feedback`. It covers just the feedback widget, whose key carries only the signal:write scope, so it can only submit feedback. Programmatic access to the rest of Foreloop goes through the CLI (with stable `--json` output and meaningful exit codes) and MCP, which are not SDKs. Missing for 10: official general-purpose SDKs for the core API (projects, loops, intentions, stories, tasks, reviews), SDK reference documentation, multi-language support, and independent corroboration.
